title.narrative: Bosnia and Herzegovina: Enhancing Social Cohesion in Communities Hosting People on the Move

description.narrative: This Action responds to the increase of tensions and anti-migrant sentiments in local communities in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) that are hosting large numbers of migrants, asylum-seekers and refugees in heavily COVID-impacted times, with a focus on Sarajevo and in Una Sana Canton (USC). The Action aims to address fears of the local population and establish a dialogue between migration management actors, local community representatives, central government stakeholders and common residents.

comment.narrative: A more general gender analysis was done previously.

Background context analyses Objectives Results and Activities of the Action have included analyses and interventions carefully considering gender age and other differences of various actors in the project. In that regard culturally sensitive age and gender appropriate measures are incorporated into assistance to people on the move and local communities. Gender analyses are also incorporated in interventions of Implementing Partners ensuring that appropriate measures are taken across the project. Gender age and diversity balance is regularly monitored through weekly reports prepared by implementing partners. Also list of participation in various activities contained gender age and diversity data and they analyzed and recorded appropriately. Partnership has been established with two women association who have implemented creative activities with women and man in TRCs and residents who were willing to participate. Important to highlight is that migrant women are additionally encouraged to participate in the cultural sport and creative activities which they have not experienced earlier.

Hence all stakeholders defined in the Action document are included in the implementation phase in accordance with their respective role and expertise. comment.narrative: Equal participation of women and girls men and boys is incorporated into the Action interventions ensuring gender mainstreaming at all levels. Women and men are equally included in all project activities and they have access to all service equally. Particular attention was given to gender mainstreaming into projects that are implemented by partners ensuring that partners are sensitized in that regard and that women and girls men and boys equally participate in the activities. Working with women association we intentionally work on women empowerment as their specific needs are identified and addressed through various activities. For example football club Akademija nogometa Jedinstvo from Biha implementing partner in this project is gathering boys and girls form local communities and from TRC and encouraging them to participate in joint training sessions and football tournaments. This approach has a special significance because football has traditionally been accepted as a mens sport and this club is changing attitudes and behaviors in that regard.
